mapper.sql: t.ID AS taskId, t.TASK_NO AS taskNo, t.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, t.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.USER_PHONE AS userPhoneRaw, t.RECEIVE_PHONE AS receivePhoneRaw, t.COURIER_ID AS courierId, cr.COURIER_NAME AS courierName, cr.COURIER_PHONE AS courierPhoneRaw, t.STATION_ID AS stationId, s.STATION_NAME AS stationName, t.WATER_TYPE_ID AS waterTypeId, t.WATER_TYPE AS waterTypeName, t.CONTAINER_SPEC AS containerSpec, t.DELIVERY_COUNT AS deliveryCount, t.ACTUAL_DELIVERY_COUNT AS actualDeliveryCount, t.PLAN_RETURN_COUNT AS planReturnCount, t.ACTUAL_RETURN_COUNT AS actualReturnCount, t.WATER_AMOUNT AS waterAmountFen, t.DELIVERY_FEE AS deliveryFeeFen, t.RECEIVE_ADDRESS AS receiveAddress, t.TASK_STATUS AS taskStatus, t.SCHEDULED_TIME AS scheduledTime, t.ACCEPT_TIME AS acceptTime, t.DEPART_TIME AS departTime, t.ARRIVE_TIME AS arriveTime, t.SIGN_TIME AS signTime, t.APPEAL_DEADLINE AS appealDeadline, t.LOCATION_STATUS AS locationStatus, t.CREATE_TIME AS createTime
FROM ws_delivery_task t LEFT JOIN ws_order o ON o.ID = t.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_user u ON u.ID = t.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_courier cr ON cr.ID = t.COURIER_ID LEFT JOIN ws_station s ON s.ID = t.STATION_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.DATA_STATUS = 0
AND t.TASK_STATUS = #{bo.taskStatus}
AND (o.ORDER_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%') OR t.TASK_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%') OR u.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%') OR u.USER_PHONE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIME DESC, t.ID DESC
